evidence.quote: has ra-dial velocity8 5 3 \pm 1 2 ~ \mathrm { k m s ^ { - 1 } }

notes: SDSS J090745.0+024507 is also written HVS J090745.0+024507 at T:p3-b6; these labels are grouped as one star. Simulated HVS outcomes at T:p3-b3 are not individually catalogued and are not given separate entries.

SDSS J090745.0+024507: In T:p1-b8 the parser transcription "radial velocity8 5 3 \pm 1 2" is a mangled rendering of "radial velocity 853 ± 12 km/s" (the "8" belongs to the numerical value, not a separate symbol), consistent with the value reported by Brown et al. (2005) for SDSS J090745.0+024507. The paper's own simulations concern former companions and model ejection speeds; these are not present-day quantities of the target star and are not extracted. The mass estimate (~3 Msun) is not one of the target quantities.
